metadata.description: Curated subset of the TP-G iteration-9 manifold points (tpg_points): Qwen3-32B nf4 activation vectors for M-name (alias prompts, S-mean at block 31) and M-code PRIMARY R1 (name-scrubbed verified programs, mean over code tokens at block 33), plus the small tables the analysis stage reads and the full-run reference numbers.

subset.mname: templates t0..t1 x aliases j0..j2 x 10 algorithms (60 of 300 points)
subset.mcode_PRIMARY_R1: first 6 programs of each class in PRIMARY set order (36 of 117 points)

mname.rule: all blocks at ceiling -> nearest depth 0.5

lexical_aliases.alias: a breadth-first search run from both start and goal
A* search with a Manhattan-distance heuristic
greedy best-first search with a Manhattan heuristic
Dijkstra's algorithm with unit edge weights
jump point search (JPS) on a uniform-cost grid
A* run from both start and goal at once

n4.statement: The geometry is correlational: it describes where representations and survivors sit, not whether the model uses this geometry to choose an algorithm (iteration 7's in-manifold pushes moved 0/300).

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols):
        return []
    if not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols):
        return []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    pq = []
    heapq.heappush(pq, (0, start, [start]))
    visited = set()
    visited.add(start)
    while pq:
        _, current, path = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if current == goal:
            return path
        for dr, dc in directions:
            r, c = (current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc)
            if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and (grid[r][c] == '.') and ((r, c) not in visited):
                visited.add((r, c))
                new_path = path + [(r, c)]
                priority = abs(r - goal[0]) + abs(c - goal[1])
                heapq.heappush(pq, (priority, (r, c), new_path))
    return []
